title: Client Tenure on ClearPath and the Professional Services Projects Rate Discount
content:
For Professional Services Projects, the tenure component of the rate discount locked at signature on a time-and-materials statement of work is measured on the client's active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement.

**What is the rule?** The tenure component of the rate discount locked at signature is 1.0 percentage point when 1095 or more calendar days have passed from the go-live date of the client's active ClearPath agreement to the signature date, 0.5 percentage point when 730 to 1094 calendar days have passed, and nothing when fewer have passed or the client holds no active ClearPath agreement.

**How are the days counted?** In calendar days from the go-live date recorded on the active ClearPath agreement to the signature date, the go-live date itself counting as day 0.

| Calendar days from go-live to signature | Tenure component |
|---|---|
| 1095 or more | 1.0 |
| 730 to 1094 | 0.5 |
| fewer than 730 | nothing |
| no active ClearPath agreement | nothing |

**What happens exactly on the boundaries?** With hypothetical day counts: 729 days earns nothing, 730 days earns 0.5, 1094 days earns 0.5 and 1095 days earns 1.0.

**Does an earlier, closed ClearPath agreement count toward tenure?** No. Only the go-live date of the agreement in active status on the signature date is read.
